implementation.procedure: Replay actual CLI and full required SHA-bound guide/packet, all settings and fail-closed defaults.
implementation.acceptance: Fresh only for explicit complete closed task; no dependency truncation/settings writes.

reference_boundary.procedure: Run six boundary/accounting tests, project/guide/provenance/settings/history gates.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Missing/stale/cross-project/unknown settings or history cannot silently drop context.

data_integrity.procedure: Verify pre-dispatch sources/plan/input/parent/schema, native completed current-turn bills and original redaction.
data_integrity.acceptance: Two new no-tool turns only; exact provider last input+output, cache included, no parent bill reuse.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Compare exact revised v8 cancellation/three-blocker oracle and total input+output.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Both exact oracle answers; candidate strictly lower; first<=25000 and pair<=50000.

measurement_validity.procedure: Inspect parent/full persisted turns and actual response policies/effort/instructionSources; identical new input/schema/config/tools.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Baseline has exact prior completed parent plus current; candidate only current. Same live declared settings/instructions, no claim of visibility into provider internal hidden assembly.

reproducibility.procedure: Independent host checks current CLI/source, original raw bills, history snapshots and six tests without inference.
reproducibility.acceptance: Separate verify_experiment_result owner gates publication; scope one short closed child, not long-paper/full-workflow/cash.

scope: one dependency-complete short synthetic child; inherited one-turn parent versus fresh thread; observable native history/settings controls, provider internal assembly unobservable

oracle.next_action: Stop pending model dispatch; preserve raw data and wait for revised human direction.
blockers: No model dispatch after cancellation, including for a previously queued job.
A producer correction is not fresh independent result validation.
A literature claim never authorizes skipping required reproduction.
